items.q: CKD-mineral bone disease was previously named:
items.exp: CKD - mineral bone disease: renal osteodystrophy (previously named). (Book p811)

items.q: Renal osteodystrophy is the newer name for CKD-mineral bone disease.
opts: False — it is the previously used name
True — it replaced the older term entirely
False — both names are old and retired

items.q: High bone turnover accounts for what share of CKD-MBD?
items.exp: High bone turnover (30%); low bone turnover (10%). (Book p811)

items.q: Low bone turnover accounts for what share of CKD-MBD?
The high bone turnover entity named at the top of the page is:
items.exp: High bone turnover: osteitis fibrosa cystica. (Book p811)

items.q: In CKD, the fall in GFR creates a tendency to:
items.exp: In CKD: GFR ↓↓ → tendency to ↑ P. (Book p811)

items.q: When phosphorus rises, endothelial cells undergo:
items.exp: Endothelial cells, when P ↑, convert to osteoblast. (Book p811)

items.q: The osteoblast then traps calcium, producing:
items.exp: Osteoblast traps Ca → irreversible medial vascular calcification. (Book p811)

items.q: The medial vascular calcification produced by this osteoblast pathway is reversible.
The in-response arm: osteocytes secrete which phosphaturic substance?
FGF23 acts via the klotho receptor to block:
opts: The Na-P cotransporter (PCT) 2a, raising its activity
The ENaC channel in the collecting duct
The Na-K pump on tubular cells
items.exp: FGF23 via klotho receptor blocks Na-P cotransporter (PCT) 2a ↑ ac → phosphate excretion. (Book p811)

items.q: Match the following FGF23 action to its effect — 1) On the heart  2) On 1,2-hydroxylase  3) Net calcium … A) Inhibition  B) Left ventricular hypertrophy  C) Hypocalcemia
items.exp: FGF23 actions: LVH; 1,2-hydroxylase inhibition → calcitriol deficient → hypocalcemia. (Book p811)

items.q: The cascade from 1,2-hydroxylase inhibition runs: calcitriol deficient → hypocalcemia → stimulation of the:
items.exp: Calcitriol deficient → hypocalcemia → (+) parathyroid gland → secondary hyperparathyroidism. (Book p811)

items.q: Secondary hyperparathyroidism in this flowchart is accompanied by which pair?
In grade 5 CKD, the flowchart notes:
items.exp: In grade 5 CKD: klothoreceptor resistance. (Book p811)

items.q: In high bone turnover CKD-MBD, bone resorption outruns bone formation.
opts: False — formation >> resorption in this state
False — both formation and resorption fall together
True, but only in children with growth

items.q: The amorphous salt listed on the page is:
items.exp: Amorphous Ca₃(PO₄)₂ → tendency of trivial trauma fracture (↓ bone mineralization). (Book p811)

items.q: A CKD patient fractures a femur from trivial trauma. The bone defect named on the page is:
opts: Paget mosaic pattern of the cortex
items.exp: Amorphous Ca₃(PO₄)₂ → tendency of trivial trauma fracture (↓ bone mineralization). (Book p811)

items.q: Fill up: Bone replaced by bone + fibrous tissue + cyst gives ______.
items.exp: Bone replaced by bone + fibrous tissue + cyst → osteitis fibrosa cystica. (Book p811)
